data.name: Journey Through Nine Mile Pond: NPS Ranger-Guided Canoe Adventure
data.description:
On this 3 hour program at Nine Mile Pond, you will be guided by park rangers through the sawgrass and mangroves. You will get opportunities to experience the Everglades wilderness and its diverse habitats, animals, human history, and the vital water of the “river of grass”.

This trip can be very strenuous! Please consider your abilities and only sign up if you are physically fit and have prior canoeing experience.
data.itinerary:
* Meet Park Rangers at Nine Mile Pond, located off Main Park Road, about 25 miles away from the park’s Homestead entrance. This will take about 45 minutes from the entrance gate or 25 minutes from Flamingo.
* Advance reservations are required.
* Please arrive 30 minutes prior to the program start time to check-in (8 am).
* 8 people maximum (4 two-person canoes). You must share a two-person canoe with a member of your own party. No single person or odd number party bookings are allowed.
data.what_is_included: All paddling equipment will be provided. Canoes are metal, heavy, and long. We require two people per canoe. We provide life jackets, which everyone is required to wear, and paddles.
data.what_to_bring:
* All paddlers are required to bring plenty of water and closed-toe shoes with good tread.
* We also recommend bringing the following:
    - Sunscreen
    - Hat
    - Sunglasses
    - Bug spray or bug jacket
    - Snacks
    - Paddling gloves
    - Breathable long pants and long-sleeve shirt
    - Binoculars
data.cancellation_notes:
Please be courteous and cancel with as much advance notice as possible so we can open your spot to other visitors.

We will only cancel the trip if there is severe weather preventing us from leading a safe experience. You will receive notification via email as well as a phone call. Conditions that may result in a cancellation include thunderstorms, lightning, or high winds. The trip could also be canceled if there is not enough water to safely follow the route.
data.booking_notes:
**Journey Through Nine Mile Pond: NPS Ranger-Guided Canoe Adventure**

**Departure Location:**
Where to Meet:
Please meet us at Nine Mile Pond, about 45 minutes from the Ernest F. Coe Visitor Center in Homestead or about 25 minutes from Flamingo.

When to Meet: 
Please arrive at least **30 minutes** prior to your program to check-in. We ask that you arrive by 8 am to take care of last-minute logistics, sign your waivers, and prepare to paddle. If you do not check-in with a ranger by 8:15 am, your place on the tour may be forfeited to other visitors. If you miss the 8:30 am safety talk, you are not permitted on the paddle.

**There are no restroom facilities at Nine Mile Pond. Use the restrooms at the Ernest F. Coe Visitor Center before the Homestead Main Entrance gate or West Lake if coming from Flamingo.**

**What to Bring:**
•	Water (required)
•	Closed-toe shoes with good tread (required)
•	Snacks
•	Hat
•	Sunglasses
•	Sunscreen
•	Bug spray or bug jacket
•	Binoculars
•	Towel
•	Dry bags
•	Breathable long-sleeve shirt and long pants

**Important Reminders:**
•	Prior paddling experience is required. If rangers don’t feel you can complete the trip safely, they may ask you to remove yourself from the trip.
•	All minors must have an adult (18+) in the canoe with them.
•	Everyone will be issued life jackets and are required to wear them for the entire paddle.
•	All visitors are required to sign a waiver. Parents or legal guardians can sign for minors.
•	There are no bathrooms available at Nine Mile Pond. The closest bathrooms are 10 minutes away at West Lake.
•	You may be asked to help us lift or move kayaks or canoes short distances.
•	Plan to get wet. You may want to leave valuables, such as phones or cameras, behind so they don’t get wet. A park ranger will bring a dry bag for your car keys, but will not carry any other belongings for you. The park and its rangers are not responsible for any damage to your personal belongings.

We look forward to seeing you in the ‘Glades soon!

If you have any questions, please email FlamingoVisitorCenter@gmail.com or call (239) 695-2945. Please allow 24 hours for a response.
data.check_in_details:
You will check-in with a park ranger at Nine Mile Pond, about 25 miles past the Ernest F. Coe Visitor Center. Allow up to 45 minutes for this drive. Follow signs for Nine Mile Pond. 

Please arrive at least 30 minutes early to check-in (arrive by 8 am). If you are late, we reserve the right to give another visitor your place.

Adults over the age of 18 must complete and submit their own waiver. Minors ages 17 and younger must have a parent or legal guardian sign a waiver on behalf of the minor. All minors must have an adult in the canoe with them.
data.special_requirements:
* For the safety of all guests, we require that all paddlers are 12 years and older. Minors who are not paddling must weigh at least 50lbs (23 kg). Boats are limited to two people (ages 12+) and one child (50-90 lbs).
* We require that you have prior paddling experience on this moderately strenuous trip. You will be paddling for the full three hours with very few stops. Paddling in Everglades National Park can be a strenuous activity; when water levels are low, paddling can require more strength and stamina. You must be able to paddle the whole trip. Before the trip begins, we will require that you demonstrate paddling proficiency.
* Our canoes require two paddlers to safely maneuver along the route. Only even-numbered bookings are allowed.
* All minors must be accompanied by an adult in their canoes.
* The canoes are metal with no back support.
* You may be asked to assist us in lifting and/or moving the canoes.
* To best accommodate you and make your trip safe and enjoyable, please notify park rangers when checking-in if:
    - You have had any recent surgeries
    - You have any back injuries
    - You have any medical conditions or allergies
    - You are pregnant
    - You have other concerns regarding your safety or health
